project: UNNS Turbulence — Johns Hopkins Turbulence Database

rules: Treat the canonical HDF5 source as immutable.
Do not treat the 256^3 cutout as periodic.
Keep physical derivation upstream of STRUC-ROUTE-I.
Do not modify canonical STRUC-I or STRUC-PERC-I.
Keep chamber implementation inside chambers/, not in the project root.
Keep project-root MANIFEST.json and README.txt project-level only.
Preserve source provenance, hashes, and frozen pilot settings.
